connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed identical to US3_MS3: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -10.261) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm) touching the radiating edge y=-3.661 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

US3_MS3.note: Comparison variable: the radiating element (U-slot -> plain rectangle) at the same target fr; L is tied to it (rescaled so the resonance stays at f0). Material, h, board, W, 50 ohm line width, transformer w/l, port type/position and mesh profile unchanged.

P01_R2.note: P01_R2 probe result is not reused as matching evidence (owner decision 2026-11-05).

rationale: Owner decision 2026-11-05 requires redoing P01_R2 with the microstrip feed. For a clean comparison with the best owner-feed candidate (US3_MS3) the same FR4 h 2.07 mm and the same 50 ohm line + lambda/4 are kept; only the element changes. L = 7.67 mm * 7.625/7.9872 = 7.322 mm from the EM fit of US0 (plain rectangle, h 2.07, fine mesh, fr 7.625 GHz); the same L*fr scaling took US3 -> US3_MS2 to within -0.65/+0.70 % of f0 in EM. TL-model edge resistance of the plain rectangle (G1+G12) is ~300 ohm, within the EM range of the U-slot edge (243-296 ohm), so the ~102 ohm transformer is a consistent first choice. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11 claimed.

computation.method: em/circuit_fits/P01_MS1_design.py (L*fr scaling from US0 fit; Balanis TL G1/G12 edge resistance)

manufacturability.note: Transformer 0.80 mm wide, same as US3_MS3; feed continuous from board edge to patch edge; no slots.

purpose: Owner-feed P01 (rectangular patch) on the same material and feed as US3_MS3: does the U-slot buy channel coverage over a plain rectangle?

pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Base mesh, 50 ohm lumped port at y=-13: the channel S11 minimum lies within 7.85-8.15 GHz (L scaling works without slot).
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: Worst |S11| in 7.7376-8.2368 GHz is WORSE (higher) than US3_MS3 base mesh (-8.18 dB) because the plain rectangle has narrower bandwidth (higher Q) than the U-slot.
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: Worst <= -6 dB -> fine mesh next (two-mesh rule of claude_run_016). Worst > -6 dB with H1 true -> P01 rectangle is inferior to US3_MS3 under the owner feed; recalibrate l_t/Zt only once from this port-plane data, otherwise concentrate on US3_MS3/P03. H1 false -> rescale L from this run's resonance before any feed change.
